solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Beset by stress, I had mishap

indicators.note: to be beset by something is to be surrounded by it, so the stress word wraps round the other piece

parts.note: stress on a syllable is its accent
I had contracts to I'd

explanation.surface: Someone under strain confesses to having had a mishap.
explanation.definitionFit: An unplanned, unlucky event is both a mishap and an accident.

clue.text: Dog has to be seen in church

indicators.note: a thing seen in something else sits inside it, so one piece goes within the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
taken as written

explanation.surface: A dog turns up during a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: To dog someone is to follow or pursue them closely, a verb sense of chase.

clue.text: Takes no notice of Italian gentleman, first to last

indicators.note: the instruction moves the opening letter of the Italian word round to the end

parts.note: signore is Italian for a gentleman or sir

explanation.surface: Someone snubs an Italian gentleman at every turn.
explanation.definitionFit: Disregarding someone or paying them no attention is the plain meaning.

clue.text: See bank sacking head

indicators.note: dismissing the head means losing the first letter of the bank word

parts.note: to bank on someone is to rely on them

explanation.surface: A bank fires its chief executive, as the clue pretends.
explanation.walkthrough: A See is a bishop's diocese; Ely, a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire, England, has one.
explanation.definitionFit: Ely is an English cathedral city and diocese, and a bishop's diocese is called a see.

clue.text: Enraged at unruly outdoor refreshment area

indicators.note: unruly means disorderly, so the letters of these two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: An angry, rowdy customer in a garden café.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea garden is an open-air place where tea and snacks are served.

clue.text: Mad attempt to make return journey

indicators.note: a return journey goes back the way it came, so the attempt word is read backwards

parts.note: to have a stab is to make an attempt

explanation.surface: Trying to get home again is a crazy idea.
explanation.definitionFit: Bats is informal slang for crazy or insane.

clue.text: Convey hint of blessedness with token gift at wedding

indicators.note: a hint is just a trace, here the opening letter of blessedness

parts.note: a wedding ring is the token exchanged at a marriage

explanation.surface: Bringing a blessed little present to a wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: To convey something is to carry or take it along, a synonym.

clue.text: Crook? Checker was one

explanation.surface: A crook is unmasked by the checker who catches him.
explanation.walkthrough: Chubby Checker was the US singer who made the Twist dance famous with 'The Twist', so he was a twister.
explanation.definitionFit: A swindler is a twister; and someone dancing the Twist, like Chubby Checker, is a twister.

clue.text: Fine 24 hours outside home before onset of tiredness

indicators.note: the day word sits outside, wrapping round the other pieces

parts.note: a day lasts 24 hours

indicators.note: the home piece comes before the tiredness letter

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: the onset is the start, so the first letter of tiredness

explanation.surface: A lovely day spent at home before getting sleepy.
explanation.definitionFit: Something delicate and finely made is dainty.

clue.text: Sour old dictator Amin appearing in a cricket club

indicators.note: one piece shows up inside the other, so the dictator goes within the cricket club letters

parts.note: Idi Amin was the dictator of Uganda in the 1970s

explanation.surface: A grim old Ugandan dictator turns up at a cricket club.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasting sharp or tart like vinegar is being acidic, a synonym.

clue.text: Busy person initially refused drink

parts.note: a busy bee is a hard-working person

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of refused

explanation.surface: A hard-working person turned down an offered drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Beer is an example of an alcoholic drink.

clue.text: What may make for windy home game

definitions.text: What may make for windy home

explanation.surface: Draughty houses and board games go together on a winter evening.
explanation.walkthrough: Draughts is the British name for checkers, the board game.
explanation.definitionFit: Cold currents of air make a house windy, and the board game known in the US as checkers carries the same name.

clue.text: Mother country in state of perpetual doom

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, especially a horse
a nation is a country

explanation.surface: A mother country fallen into endless ruin.
explanation.definitionFit: Eternal punishment in hell is the theological condition of being damned forever.

clue.text: Big noise son's got in chest

indicators.note: the son has got inside, so his letter is placed within the noise word

parts.note: a boom is a loud deep sound
S is the abbreviation for son; the 's stands for has

explanation.surface: A son's loud voice comes from deep in his chest.
explanation.definitionFit: Bosom is another word for the breast or chest.

clue.text: Coarse expression of disapproval upset husband, gentleman

parts.note: boo is the cry of disapproval at a show

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the husband and gentleman letters are read backwards

parts.note: sir is the title for a gentleman

explanation.surface: Booing upsets a husband who is a gentleman.
explanation.definitionFit: Rough, ill-mannered and uncouth behaviour is described as boorish.

clue.text: Odd editor making comeback? Object

indicators.note: coming back means going in the opposite direction, so the two words are read backwards

parts.note: rum is old-fashioned British slang for odd or strange

explanation.surface: An eccentric editor returning, to which someone objects.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise an objection or show reluctance is to demur, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Swallow tiny amount of intoxicating drink

parts.note: a martin is a bird of the swallow family

indicators.note: only a tiny amount is taken, the first letter of intoxicating

explanation.surface: Sipping only a little of a strong drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A martini is a cocktail of gin or vodka with vermouth.

clue.text: Grumble about old male — outspoken?

parts.note: C is circa, Latin for about
plain-spoken, frank speech is plain

explanation.surface: Someone moans about an old man who speaks his mind.
explanation.definitionFit: To grumble is to moan or express dissatisfaction, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Three maybe in monks' hour of prayer

explanation.surface: Three monks keep an early hour of prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: Three is an example of a number divisible only by itself and one; the first daytime office of monastic prayer has the same name.

clue.text: Discourteous duke stuck in Parisian street

indicators.note: the duke is stuck inside the street word

parts.note: rue is French for street

explanation.surface: An impolite nobleman is stuck in a Paris road.
explanation.definitionFit: Impolite, ill-mannered behaviour is rude.

clue.text: Arrange location with no prior publicity

indicators.note: the prior or leading part is dropped, so the publicity letters come off the front

parts.note: an address is the location of a building
an ad is publicity

explanation.surface: Organising a venue without advance advertising.
explanation.definitionFit: To arrange items neatly in order, as when soldiers line up or a shop window is displayed, is to dress them.

clue.text: Cycle, exuding energy in one skimpy garment

indicators.note: giving off energy means losing the energy letter from the cycle word

parts.note: a bike is a cycle
E is the symbol for energy
taken as written
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A sweaty cyclist rides along in a tiny outfit.
explanation.definitionFit: A bikini is a brief two-piece swimsuit.

clue.text: They receive confetti, scattered debris

indicators.note: scattered means thrown about, so the letters of debris are rearranged

explanation.surface: Confetti is thrown and lies about like litter.
explanation.definitionFit: Newly married women are showered with paper confetti at weddings.

clue.text: Vehicle broken with tailpiece dropping off

indicators.note: the tail falls away, so the last letter of the broken word goes

parts.note: bust means broken

explanation.surface: A vehicle breaks down after its rear part falls off.
explanation.definitionFit: A bus is a large road vehicle carrying passengers.

clue.text: You and I entertaining ambassador? That's exciting!

indicators.note: to entertain a guest is to hold them, so the pair contains the ambassador

parts.note: you and I together are we
HE is His Excellency, the title of an ambassador

explanation.surface: Hosting an ambassador is a thrill.
explanation.definitionFit: Whee is a cry of delight or excitement.

clue.text: Most unpleasant loony in States

indicators.note: loony means crazy, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: The worst crazy people are found in America.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of nasty, meaning least pleasant of all.
